generations.name: Series I
generations.notes: About 102 kWh usable pack (about 120 kWh gross per InsideEVs), peak DC about 195-205 kW, 10-80 % in about 34 min. Spectre and Black Badge Spectre (more power) share the pack. First deliveries Q4 2023 (MY2024). Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolls-Royce_Spectre ; https://insideevs.com/news/797596/rolls-royce-spectre-series-two/

generations.name: Series II
generations.notes: Announced 2 Jun 2026 as MY2027: re-engineered cells, 112.4 kWh usable / 118 kWh gross (third-party figure), charging up to 14 % quicker per Rolls-Royce, WLTP range up 18 %. Rolls-Royce does not say the peak changed. EPA has MY2027 Spectre rows, which fall here; NRCan has none yet. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/797596/rolls-royce-spectre-series-two/ ; https://www.bmwblog.com/2026/06/02/rolls-royce-spectre-more-range-and-power/
